_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Meaningful Holiday#000.src: If you want to help someone else this year, our boss Nick is already out in the thick of it.

Meaningful Holiday#002.src: I'm sorry but everyfin is sold out, everyone is preparing for Craftmas.

Meaningful Holiday#003.src: I might have something on the attic, if you find anyfin, you can 'ave it. I know how difficult it gets.

Meaningful Holiday#004.src: Did ye find anyfin in the attic?

Meaningful Holiday#005.src: Looks like I'm fresh outta food. Barely got enough to feed meself.

Meaningful Holiday#006.src: Oh, also, can you give this blanket to Margaret while you're down in the tunnel? Just follow the road behind me.

Meaningful Holiday#008.src: Oh, please don't move me along. I have no where else to go!

Meaningful Holiday#009.src: Heya! I just finished decorating this craftmas tree!

Meaningful Holiday#011.src: I've been wrapping presents all week long.

Meaningful Holiday#012.src: My hands are starting to hurt!

Meaningful Holiday#013.src: Get out before I call the guards!

Meaningful Holiday#014.src: Stealing is not in the Craftmas spirit... But I think I can make this work.

Meaningful Holiday#015.src: My siblings and I take care of people at Craftmas. My area is the {p} desert. I guess you could call me Sanda Claus, heh.

Meaningful Holiday#016.dst: {p} の [{~}, {~}, -{~}] にいる Haily と話す

Meaningful Holiday#017.src: Hello, dear. My name is Haily. Nice to meet you.
Meaningful Holiday#017.dst: こんにちは。私は Haily、よろしくね。
Meaningful Holiday#017.speaker: Haily

Meaningful Holiday#018.src: This is the {p} Charity center. We're looking for volunteers to help the homeless this year.
Meaningful Holiday#018.dst: ここは {p} 慈善センターよ。今年はホームレスの人たちを助けるボランティアを探しているの。
Meaningful Holiday#018.speaker: Haily

Meaningful Holiday#019.src: If you want to help someone else this year, our boss Nick is already in the thick of it.
Meaningful Holiday#019.dst: 今年誰かの役に立ちたいなら、うちの責任者 Nick がもう現場で奮闘中よ。
Meaningful Holiday#019.speaker: Haily

Meaningful Holiday#020.src: He's a really special man. I'll write his location down for you in your book. Oh, remember this is charity work, so hopefully gratitude is a good enough reward for you.
Meaningful Holiday#020.dst: 本当に特別な人なの。居場所をあなたの本に書いておくわね。あ、これは慈善活動だから、感謝の気持ちが報酬で足りるといいんだけど。
Meaningful Holiday#020.speaker: Haily

Meaningful Holiday#021.src: Go talk to Haily's friend Nick at the poor area.
Meaningful Holiday#021.dst: 貧民街にいる Haily の友人 Nick と話す。

Meaningful Holiday#022.src: Oh. Oh... Oh dear. There's more people here than ever.
Meaningful Holiday#022.dst: ああ。ああ…なんてことだ。これまでで一番人が多い。
Meaningful Holiday#022.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#023.src: Hm, are you just passing through? Oh! A volunteer!
Meaningful Holiday#023.dst: ん、通りすがりかい？おお！ボランティアか！
Meaningful Holiday#023.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#024.src: You're the only one this year. Things have really changed. We used to have hundreds of volunteers this time of year.
Meaningful Holiday#024.dst: 今年は君一人だけだ。本当に変わってしまった。昔はこの時期、何百人もボランティアがいたのに。
Meaningful Holiday#024.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#025.src: The people here are starving. There's no two ways about it.
Meaningful Holiday#025.dst: ここの人たちは飢えている。紛れもない事実だ。
Meaningful Holiday#025.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#026.src: I don't know how we're going to feed everyone this year.
Meaningful Holiday#026.dst: 今年はどうやって皆に食べさせればいいのか。
Meaningful Holiday#026.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#027.src: The man who runs the budget store used to be homeless... He knows the struggles they face.
Meaningful Holiday#027.dst: 安売り店の主人は昔ホームレスだった…彼らの苦しみを分かっている人だ。
Meaningful Holiday#027.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#028.src: I'll look after things here. Can you go to the budget store? It's really close. Any food is gratefully received.
Meaningful Holiday#028.dst: ここは私が見ておく。安売り店に行ってくれないか？すぐ近くだ。食べ物なら何でもありがたい。
Meaningful Holiday#028.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#029.src: Go to the budget store and ask for food.
Meaningful Holiday#029.dst: 安売り店に行って食べ物を頼む。

Meaningful Holiday#031.src: What can I do fer ye?
Meaningful Holiday#031.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#032.dst: ホームレスに食いもんの寄付だって？
Meaningful Holiday#032.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#033.src: I'm sorry but everyfin is sold out, everyone is preparing for Craftmas lad.
Meaningful Holiday#033.dst: 悪いがなんもかんも売り切れだ、みんな Craftmas の支度でな、若いの。
Meaningful Holiday#033.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#034.src: I might have something in the attic, if you find anyfin, you can 'ave it. I know how difficult it gets.
Meaningful Holiday#034.dst: 屋根裏に何かあるかもしれねえ、見つけたら持ってっていい。つらいのはよく分かるからよ。
Meaningful Holiday#034.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#035.src: Look for food on the second floor.

Meaningful Holiday#036.src: Hm... This apple has seen betta days...
Meaningful Holiday#036.dst: むう…このリンゴは盛りを過ぎてんな…
Meaningful Holiday#036.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#037.src: Looks like i'm fresh outta food. Barely got enough to feed myself.
Meaningful Holiday#037.dst: どうやら食いもんは空っぽだ。自分が食う分もギリギリでよ。
Meaningful Holiday#037.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#038.src: I wish I had something to give this year. I guess people are having a feast in the city.
Meaningful Holiday#038.dst: 今年も何かやれりゃよかったんだが。街の連中はごちそうを食ってるんだろうな。
Meaningful Holiday#038.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#039.src: Return to Nick and tell him the bad news.
Meaningful Holiday#039.dst: Nick のもとに戻って悪い知らせを伝える。

Meaningful Holiday#041.src: I see. I was counting on him.
Meaningful Holiday#041.dst: そうか。彼を頼りにしていたんだが。
Meaningful Holiday#041.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#042.src: I can't be too upset. He donates so much the rest of the year.
Meaningful Holiday#042.dst: 責めることはできない。ほかの時期はたくさん寄付してくれるんだ。
Meaningful Holiday#042.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#043.src: We may have to ask the farmers directly...
Meaningful Holiday#043.dst: 農家に直接頼むしかないかもしれない…
Meaningful Holiday#043.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#044.src: I know someone in {p} with a kind heart.
Meaningful Holiday#044.dst: {p} に心優しい知り合いがいる。
Meaningful Holiday#044.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#045.src: We've fallen out before, seems he didn't understand what a donation was.
Meaningful Holiday#045.dst: 前に仲違いしてね、寄付というものが分かっていないようだった。
Meaningful Holiday#045.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#046.src: There is a shortcut south from here, in a cave. Go through there.
Meaningful Holiday#046.dst: ここから南の洞窟に近道がある。そこを通って行ってくれ。
Meaningful Holiday#046.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#047.src: Oh, also, could you give this blanket to Margaret while you're down in the tunnel? Just follow the road behind me.
Meaningful Holiday#047.dst: ああそれと、トンネルを通るついでにこの毛布を Margaret に渡してくれないか？私の後ろの道をたどればいい。
Meaningful Holiday#047.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#048.src: Bring the blanket to the woman in the tunnel south of Nick.
Meaningful Holiday#048.dst: Nick の南にあるトンネルにいる女性に毛布を届ける。

Meaningful Holiday#049.src: Oh, please don't move me along. I have nowhere else to go!
Meaningful Holiday#049.dst: ああ、どうか追い出さないで。ほかに行く所がないの！
Meaningful Holiday#049.speaker: Margaret

Meaningful Holiday#050.src: Oh, a blanket for me? How sweet... From Nick, you say? He's always so kind... Thank you, as well.
Meaningful Holiday#050.dst: まあ、私に毛布を？優しいのね…Nick から？あの人はいつも親切ね…あなたもありがとう。
Meaningful Holiday#050.speaker: Margaret

Meaningful Holiday#051.src: If you want to get to {p} quickly, just keep going through this tunnel. Some unfriendly homeless folks live around here too, so be careful. It's so sad, their state.
Meaningful Holiday#051.dst: {p} へ急ぐなら、このトンネルをそのまま進みなさい。この辺には乱暴な浮浪者も住んでいるから気をつけて。あの人たちの有様は本当に悲しいわ。
Meaningful Holiday#051.speaker: Margaret

Meaningful Holiday#052.src: Continue the tunnel and find Nick's friend.
Meaningful Holiday#052.dst: トンネルを進んで Nick の友人を探す。

Meaningful Holiday#053.src: Welcome to my farm! Looking to buy some of my fresh crops?
Meaningful Holiday#053.dst: 俺の農場へようこそ！採れたての作物を買いに来たのかい？
Meaningful Holiday#053.speaker: Reshad

Meaningful Holiday#054.src: Well, it seems you're out of luck. I've just sold the last of them from this harvest.
Meaningful Holiday#054.dst: あいにくだったな。今年の収穫の残りは、ついさっき売り切れたところだ。
Meaningful Holiday#054.speaker: Reshad

Meaningful Holiday#055.src: It was all for that big Craftmas feast happening in {p}. Wish I could help you out, but I'm fresh out of food to sell you.
Meaningful Holiday#055.dst: 全部 {p} の Craftmas の大宴会用さ。力になりたいが、売れる食べ物はもう何もないんだ。
Meaningful Holiday#055.speaker: Reshad

Meaningful Holiday#056.src: Wait, I bet Nick sent you, didn't he? Well, he's coming up on your left. Remind him that this isn't a charity.
Meaningful Holiday#056.dst: 待てよ、Nick に言われて来たんだろ？ほら、左から来たぞ。ここは慈善事業じゃないって言っといてくれ。
Meaningful Holiday#056.speaker: Reshad

Meaningful Holiday#058.src: We can't get any food? We're running out of options here...
Meaningful Holiday#058.dst: 食べ物が手に入らない？もう打つ手がなくなってきた…
Meaningful Holiday#058.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#059.src: Well, there's only one person left that we can appeal to at this time of year.
Meaningful Holiday#059.dst: さて、この時期に頼れるのはあと一人しかいない。
Meaningful Holiday#059.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#061.src: Explore the area and look for Santa.
Meaningful Holiday#061.dst: 辺りを探索して Santa を探す。

Meaningful Holiday#062.src: Heya! I just finished decorating this christmas tree!
Meaningful Holiday#062.dst: やっほー！このクリスマスツリーの飾りつけが終わったとこ！
Meaningful Holiday#062.speaker: Elvura

Meaningful Holiday#064.src: He is right down the stairs to the right.
Meaningful Holiday#064.dst: 右の階段を下りたところにいるよ。
Meaningful Holiday#064.speaker: Elvura

Meaningful Holiday#065.src: Enter Santa's home and speak to him.
Meaningful Holiday#065.dst: Santa の家に入って話しかける。

Meaningful Holiday#066.dst: Nick…決まりは分かっておるじゃろう。
Meaningful Holiday#066.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#067.src: The council all have their areas to care for. Yours is {p}. How you care for it is your responsibility.
Meaningful Holiday#067.dst: 評議会の者はそれぞれ受け持ちの地域がある。お前のは {p} じゃ。どう面倒を見るかはお前の責任じゃよ。
Meaningful Holiday#067.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#068.src: There's five times more homeless and hungry than last year!
Meaningful Holiday#068.dst: 去年の五倍もホームレスと飢えた人がいるんだ！
Meaningful Holiday#068.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#069.src: Nick, I know times are tough there, but-
Meaningful Holiday#069.dst: Nick、そちらが大変なのは分かるが―
Meaningful Holiday#069.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#070.src: Tough?! It's impossible! What happened to people's good will? I had one volunteer this year! ONE!
Meaningful Holiday#070.dst: 大変？！不可能だよ！人々の善意はどこへ行った？今年のボランティアは一人だ！一人！
Meaningful Holiday#070.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#071.src: I'm sorry Nick. You could go to {p} and ask there, they have a feast big enough to feed an army!
Meaningful Holiday#071.dst: すまんのう、Nick。{p} で頼んでみてはどうじゃ、あそこの宴会は軍隊でも養えるほどじゃ！
Meaningful Holiday#071.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#072.src: Hmmm... Oh, sorry. I miscalculated your journey here. Good to see you.
Meaningful Holiday#072.dst: うーん…おっと、すまない。君が来るまでの時間を見誤った。会えてよかった。
Meaningful Holiday#072.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#073.src: I suppose you heard Santa and I. Our next location is {p}.
Meaningful Holiday#073.dst: Santa との話は聞こえただろう。次の行き先は {p} だ。
Meaningful Holiday#073.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#074.src: Alright, that's settled then. Leave through the fireplace behind me, it will bring you directly to {p}. Good luck, Nick.
Meaningful Holiday#074.dst: よし、決まりじゃな。わしの後ろの暖炉から出れば、まっすぐ {p} へ行ける。幸運を祈るぞ、Nick。
Meaningful Holiday#074.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#075.src: Leave through the portal behind Santa.
Meaningful Holiday#075.dst: Santa の後ろのポータルから出る。

Meaningful Holiday#077.src: Wow. The people here live in such grandure. I wonder if they know people are starving to the east.
Meaningful Holiday#077.dst: わあ。ここの人たちはなんと豪勢な暮らしだ。東で人が飢えているのを知っているんだろうか。
Meaningful Holiday#077.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#078.src: Let's ask around for some donations.
Meaningful Holiday#078.dst: 寄付をお願いして回ろう。
Meaningful Holiday#078.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#079.src: More importantly, let's hope they'll share a trifle of food.
Meaningful Holiday#079.dst: 何より、食べ物を少しでも分けてくれるといいんだが。
Meaningful Holiday#079.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#082.dst: この催しは招待客限定だ。
Meaningful Holiday#082.speaker: Server

Meaningful Holiday#083.src: You aren't even in a formal dress.
Meaningful Holiday#083.dst: 正装すらしていないじゃないか。
Meaningful Holiday#083.speaker: Server

Meaningful Holiday#085.src: Food? You want food? Does this look like a charity to you?
Meaningful Holiday#085.dst: 食べ物？食べ物だと？ここが慈善施設に見えるのか？
Meaningful Holiday#085.speaker: Server

Meaningful Holiday#086.src: Of course not! We have an obligation to feed our partygoers, not some poor scraps of men in the desert!
Meaningful Holiday#086.dst: 見えるわけがない！我々の義務は宴の客をもてなすことだ、砂漠の貧乏人どもに恵むことではない！
Meaningful Holiday#086.speaker: Server

Meaningful Holiday#087.src: Now get out of here before I call the security golems. And don't even think of stealing from the kitchen!
Meaningful Holiday#087.dst: 警備ゴーレムを呼ばれる前に出て行け。厨房から盗もうなんて考えるなよ！
Meaningful Holiday#087.speaker: Server

Meaningful Holiday#088.src: Steal the food from the kitchen and talk to Nick.
Meaningful Holiday#088.dst: 厨房から食べ物を盗み、Nick と話す。

Meaningful Holiday#089.src: Were you able to get any food?
Meaningful Holiday#089.dst: 食べ物はもらえたかい？
Meaningful Holiday#089.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#090.src: You do?! I didn't expect them to be so generous, a whole crate?
Meaningful Holiday#090.dst: もらえた？！そんなに気前がいいとは、まるごと一箱も？
Meaningful Holiday#090.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#093.src: Stealing is not in the christmas spirit... But I think I can make this work.
Meaningful Holiday#093.dst: 盗みはクリスマスの精神に反する…だが、これは生かせそうだ。
Meaningful Holiday#093.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#094.src: Go on ahead. I have a plan. Don't worry, I'll return all this food.
Meaningful Holiday#094.dst: 先に行ってくれ。考えがある。心配しないで、食べ物は全部返すよ。
Meaningful Holiday#094.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#095.dst: Nick と一緒に舞踏会から脱出する。

Meaningful Holiday#096.dst: 皆さん、聞いてください！
Meaningful Holiday#096.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#097.src: I know you are hungry. Because I am too.
Meaningful Holiday#097.dst: お腹が空いているでしょう。私もです。
Meaningful Holiday#097.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#098.src: But your dinner will not be served tonight.
Meaningful Holiday#098.dst: ですが今夜、夕食は出ません。
Meaningful Holiday#098.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#099.src: There will be no Craftmas feast this year!
Meaningful Holiday#099.dst: 今年は Craftmas の宴はありません！
Meaningful Holiday#099.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#100.dst: そんなことは許されないぞ！
Meaningful Holiday#100.speaker: Guest

Meaningful Holiday#101.src: The food on the table isn't enough to feed everyone here!
Meaningful Holiday#101.dst: テーブルの料理だけじゃ、ここにいる全員の腹は満たせないぞ！
Meaningful Holiday#101.speaker: Guest

Meaningful Holiday#102.src: This one night, this one missed meal.
Meaningful Holiday#102.dst: たった一晩、たった一食を抜くだけ。
Meaningful Holiday#102.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#103.src: This is how thousands of people live every day.
Meaningful Holiday#103.dst: 何千もの人々が、毎日そうやって暮らしています。
Meaningful Holiday#103.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#104.src: Hungry, wondering when the food will be available.
Meaningful Holiday#104.dst: 空腹のまま、次はいつ食べられるかと思いながら。
Meaningful Holiday#104.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#105.src: And while you sit there with empty stomachs be thankful for what you have. Spare a thought for those who have not.
Meaningful Holiday#105.dst: 空っぽのお腹で座っている間、自分が持つものに感謝してください。持たない人々を思ってください。
Meaningful Holiday#105.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#106.src: Hundreds of men, women and children, just like you, will not eat tonight, at all.
Meaningful Holiday#106.dst: あなた方と同じ何百もの男、女、子どもが、今夜は何一つ口にできないのです。
Meaningful Holiday#106.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#107.src: All because this enormous feast was not enough. {p} bought all the food, cheap or expensive.
Meaningful Holiday#107.dst: すべてはこの巨大な宴でも足りなかったから。{p} は安い物も高い物も、食べ物を買い占めました。
Meaningful Holiday#107.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#108.src: I'm here to remind you the real meaning of this day. To think of others..
Meaningful Holiday#108.dst: 私はこの日の本当の意味を思い出させに来ました。他者を思うことを…
Meaningful Holiday#108.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#109.src: I will return your meal tonight, but while you eat it... I want you to remember every empty mouth it could have fed.
Meaningful Holiday#109.dst: 今夜の食事はお返しします。ですが食べながら…それで満たせたはずの、空っぽの口の数を思い出してください。
Meaningful Holiday#109.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#110.src: Share what you have, be thankful for what you are given.
Meaningful Holiday#110.dst: 持つものを分け合い、与えられたものに感謝を。
Meaningful Holiday#110.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#112.src: Well, looks like you came through yet again Nick.
Meaningful Holiday#112.dst: さて、またしてもやり遂げたようじゃな、Nick。

Meaningful Holiday#113.src: I came to see if I could help out. But it looks like you've done it.
Meaningful Holiday#113.dst: 手伝えることがあるかと来てみたが、もうお前がやり遂げたようじゃな。
Meaningful Holiday#113.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#114.src: Well, I guess there is only one thing left to do to complete this scene.
Meaningful Holiday#114.dst: さて、この場を締めくくるには、あと一つだけやることがあるのう。
Meaningful Holiday#114.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#115.src: Hope you all have a merry craftmas. Ho-ho!
Meaningful Holiday#115.dst: 皆、楽しい Craftmas を。ホッホー！
Meaningful Holiday#115.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#117.src: It looks like my little speech brought the rich back down to earth.
Meaningful Holiday#117.dst: 私のちょっとした演説で、金持ちたちも目が覚めたようだ。
Meaningful Holiday#117.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#118.src: They gave us half of their feast. Can you believe they still had leftovers?
Meaningful Holiday#118.dst: 宴の半分を分けてくれたよ。それでもまだ余っていたなんて信じられるかい？
Meaningful Holiday#118.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#119.src: All of that food, going straight to waste.
Meaningful Holiday#119.dst: あれだけの食べ物が、そのまま無駄になるんだ。
Meaningful Holiday#119.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#120.src: They have no idea what they have, compared to these poor folks.
Meaningful Holiday#120.dst: ここの貧しい人々に比べて、自分がどれだけ恵まれているか分かっていない。
Meaningful Holiday#120.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#121.src: You might be wondering why I know Santa. Well, he's my brother.
Meaningful Holiday#121.dst: なぜ私が Santa を知っているのか気になるだろう。実は、兄なんだ。
Meaningful Holiday#121.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#122.src: Me and my siblings take care of people at Craftmas. My area is the {p} desert. I guess you could call me Sanda Claus, heh.
Meaningful Holiday#122.dst: 私と兄弟姉妹は Craftmas に人々の世話をしている。私の担当は {p} 砂漠。砂ンタクロースとでも呼んでくれ、へへ。
Meaningful Holiday#122.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#123.src: It's people like you that keep the real meaning of this holiday alive. It gets harder every year as the meaning is distorted. Here is a personal gift from me. Thank you.
Meaningful Holiday#123.dst: 君のような人がいるから、この祝日の本当の意味が生き続けるんだ。意味がゆがめられ、年々難しくなっている。これは私からの贈り物だ。ありがとう。
Meaningful Holiday#123.speaker: Nick
